mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate compresses corporate borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns is positive over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (more than 0.5 percentage points over three months) signals improving labor market conditions and rising consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE falls by more than 0.5pp over three months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signals robust economic expansion and strong corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising INDPRO and HOUST fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a decline in inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals that the central bank is not over-tightening, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles, SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL falls by more than 0.5pp over three months.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of employment (PAYEMS) signals strong economic activity and rising corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for PAYEMS as a predictor of 5-day SPX returns is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% over three months signals a weakening real estate market and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST falls by more than 10% over three months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and unemployment (UNRATE) signals a 'Goldilocks' economy with stable growth and low inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining CPIAUCSL and UNRATE fails to produce positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a rise in housing starts (HOUST) signals continued economic momentum, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST rises by more than 5% over three months.
